classification.difficultyReason: Direct source-taught similarity test/correspondence or short guided ratio proof; all relevant constructions and numerical data supplied.

content.prompt: A line from the top of a church steeple to the ground just passes over the top of a pole 3 m high, and meets the ground at a point A, 2 m from the base of the pole. If the distance of A from a point directly below the church steeple is 22 m, find the height of the steeple.

answer.worked: The steeple and pole are vertical above the same horizontal ground, and their top points lie on the same line through A. Hence their right triangles are similar by AAA. If the steeple height is h, $\frac{h}{22}=\frac{3}{2}$, so $h=33\text{ m}$.
